entries.subject: perf(ios): activate the audio session while the video core is created (#3034)
entries.evidence: Pleazyng configures the session at launch and has separate music, PiP and car-session ownership. Early activation can interrupt another app as soon as the video screen opens. Upstream’s 25–42 ms gain was estimated in a benchmark app. Revisit after measuring first frame and testing failed opens, silent video and simultaneous music on hardware. entries.subject: perf(player): give downloads in app storage a demuxer read-ahead hysteresis (#3033)
entries.evidence: Batch demuxer refills only for uncached app-owned downloads, respecting custom mpv options and resetting the property on subsequent opens.

entries.subject: perf(player): give mpv a constant title on iOS and tvOS (#3032)
entries.evidence: The fork already sets title=mpv before initialization for the Apple mobile path. Keep the macOS window-title behavior. entries.subject: fix(livetv): re-check Live TV access after a Plex Home profile switch
entries.evidence: The probe records both the server client and authentication session. A switch on the same physical server triggers a fresh access decision and stale probe results are discarded. entries.subject: fix(ios): start Picture in Picture on a tap that also creates its controller
entries.evidence: The fork already defers a start issued by the same tap that constructed the AVKit controller and invalidates stale attempts. entries.subject: fix(watch-together): create and join rooms when the package version is unreadable

entries.subject: fix(plex): retry a server that was unreachable at launch instead of waiting for Reconnect
entries.evidence: Retry sleeping Plex servers after profile binding and resume with bounded, profile-aware backoff.

entries.subject: fix(player): strip every Samsung HDR10+ message before the Fire TV DV decoder
entries.evidence: The Samsung application-4 filter accepts variant oriented codes, including 0x0010. Existing fork native tests cover the variants. Reapplying the patch conflicts in both implementation and tests. entries.subject: fix(search): rank an artist's albums above titles that merely contain the artist
entries.evidence: Pleazyng already weights an album’s artist at 0.9. Keep its broader ranking and its regression test. entries.evidence: The loader advances past the loaded prefix and clamps the end on an empty response even when the server claims more items exist. entries.subject: fix(plex): keep a server's client when it reconnects from offline
entries.evidence: Reuse the registered Plex client when a server returns with the same authentication and profile scope, so active playback keeps reporting progress.

entries.evidence: Upstream’s official cask and tap migration identify Plezy. Pleazyng has its own signed distribution and snapetech-pleazyng cask. Importing the migration would direct fork users to the wrong product. Keep the fork’s release workflow, README and tap. entries.evidence: Build hosted iOS release IPAs on the Xcode 27 image and check the effective iOS SDK on both hosted and selected signing runners.

entries.subject: feat(player): switch 25/30 fps content to 50/60 Hz instead of 25/30 Hz
entries.evidence: Prefer precise 50/59.94/60 Hz modes for matching 25/29.97/30 fps video while preserving the existing frame-rate setting and motion-generated output path.

entries.subject: fix(player): keep the remote working when a reload unmounts the focused control
entries.evidence: The controls own the focus scope and recover surface/Play–Pause focus when the focused transport unmounts. This fixes the paused-player reload case. entries.evidence: The fork already withholds protected content when profile selection is required, clears published content and republishes after policy changes. entries.evidence: Integrated 1,901 applicable European Portuguese translations and CLDR regional routing while preserving fork translations and the separate Brazilian catalog.

entries.subject: chore(i18n): tidy pt-PT shortcut casing, picker ordering and locale tests
entries.evidence: Applied upstream sentence casing to imported shortcuts and grouped all language variants in the existing fork picker.

entries.subject: fix(profiles): ask for a profile on resume while the TV hosts the companion remote server
entries.evidence: Prompt on resume when a TV hosts the companion remote, while allowing its connected or reconnecting controller to resume normally.

entries.subject: fix(ios): show video only on external displays in iOS 27 SDK builds
entries.evidence: Register the video-only external display scene on supported iOS 27 SDKs and preserve the older scene-delegate path.

entries.subject: fix(libraries): ellipsize long library names in the phone library picker
entries.evidence: Constrain long multi-server subtitles inside the compact library picker while preserving full library choices.

entries.subject: fix(libraries): move manage and refresh into a menu on narrow phones
entries.evidence: Below 600 logical pixels the fork already puts its larger action set in an adaptive overflow menu, including karaoke, sources and Find Next. Upstream keeps Options and Shuffle direct and groups Manage/Refresh. Keep the fork’s compact approach. Borrow direct-action/empty-library focus tests if those user interactions change. [libraries_screen.dart L1140](https://github.com/snapetech-org/pleazyng/blob/b286258b783d292a5425cf1524521e38e14cdc6c/lib/screens/libraries/libraries_screen.dart#L1140)

entries.subject: fix(plex): check the server's Allow media deletion switch before deleting media
entries.evidence: Read Plex’s live deletion capability from the server root and reject confirmation when the active authentication session changes during the request.

entries.subject: fix(downloads): count purgeable space on iOS and macOS before refusing a download
entries.evidence: Use volume-specific reclaimable capacity near the storage floor on iOS and macOS, with bounded sampling and the existing guarded write and staging paths.

entries.subject: fix(downloads): stop sync rules from restarting downloads after a storage stop
entries.evidence: Rearm a storage-stopped queue only once per explicit download request, skip blocked sync-rule passes, and keep in-flight retries from clearing the storage error.

entries.subject: fix(tv): reach the profile menu from an empty Home with the D-pad
entries.evidence: Keep the TV profile menu, Retry and sidebar reachable when Home has no server rows, including the fork’s cloud-only rail.

pull_requests.author: smee2018
pull_requests.title: fix(tv): let the description use the full width in TV layout
pull_requests.decision: Adapted in Pleazyng. Give long TV summaries the available width while keeping titles, metadata, actions and the fork’s directional layout in their existing columns.

pull_requests.author: veresvit
pull_requests.title: feat(tvos): allow disabling dynamic Top Shelf content
pull_requests.decision: Adapted in Pleazyng. Apple TV users can choose static Top Shelf artwork for every profile. The extension and publisher honor the device setting alongside existing PIN and profile restrictions.

pull_requests.author: NoahBK
pull_requests.title: feat(settings): choose screenshot save location
pull_requests.decision: Adapted in Pleazyng. Desktop users can select or reset the screenshot folder. macOS remembers the user-approved folder with a security-scoped bookmark, and mpv retains its Pictures default.

pull_requests.author: Ugoyo
pull_requests.title: feat(android): install updates from the GitHub release in the app
pull_requests.decision: Skip the generic Android in-app updater for parity. Any future direct-APK updater should be scoped to that distribution channel.

pull_requests.author: wetpas
pull_requests.title: feat(seerr): "My requests" in Explore, with delete and remove actions
pull_requests.decision: Adapted in Pleazyng. Allow users to withdraw their own pending film or TV request. The client rechecks the request, owner, title and edition before deleting the request record. Library files remain under the server administrator’s control.

pull_requests.author: denizt
pull_requests.title: feat(metadata): add refresh metadata context menu item
pull_requests.decision: Adapted in Pleazyng. Allow authorized Plex owners to refresh one item. Cache invalidation and detail updates check the selected server, session and settled item ID.

pull_requests.title: feat(home): merge Recently Added rows across libraries (#1652)
pull_requests.decision: The fork already aggregates sources for merged Recently Added rows (#1652). Check ordering/deduplication tests before importing anything.

pull_requests.title: feat(deep-links): play and shuffle video playlists from plezy:// links
pull_requests.decision: Adapted in Pleazyng. Play ordered or shuffled video playlists from fork links while retaining server and active profile ownership and the existing music routes.
